name: SBIR/STTR (government-wide framework)
what: SBIR and STTR are authorized by section 9 of the [Small Business Act](#term:small-business-act), codified at 15 [U.S.C.](#term:usc) 638, and governed by the SBA SBIR/STTR Policy Directive effective May 3, 2023 [3](#cite:3)[5](#cite:5).
